learning_objective: 🎯 [Kids will learn what makes a complete sentence and how to identify its two main parts: the Subject and the Predicate.]
warm_up_hook: 📖 Welcome to Class 3! 🎉 Have you ever wondered how words team up to tell a story? Today, we will learn how to make words hold hands to create perfect sentences!

lesson_modules.module_title: 📝 What is a Sentence? (वाक्य क्या है?)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: A sentence is a group of words that makes complete sense. It must always start with a Capital Letter and usually ends with a Full Stop (.). If the words are mixed up, they don't mean anything!
examples_or_templates: Not a sentence: playing park boy the in is.
A proper sentence: The boy is playing in the park.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Every sentence has two parts. The first part is the Subject. The Subject tells us 'who' or 'what' the sentence is about. It is usually a noun or a pronoun.
examples_or_templates: [The little girl] is eating an apple. (Subject: The little girl)
[My pet dog] barks loudly. (Subject: My pet dog)

lesson_modules.teaching_content: The second part of the sentence is the Predicate. The Predicate tells us something about the subject. It always contains the verb (action word).
examples_or_templates: Birds [fly in the sky]. (Predicate: fly in the sky)

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Which of these is a complete and correct sentence?
options: The big blue car is driving fast.
practice_mcq_quiz.correct_answer: The big blue car is driving fast.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Identify the Subject in this sentence: 'Rohan plays cricket.'

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Rearrange these words to make a sentence: milk / likes / cat / The / drink / to
subjective_practice.hint: Start with 'The cat' and don't forget the full stop!

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Underline the Subject and circle the Predicate in this sentence: The bright stars shine at night.
subjective_practice.hint: Who is shining? That is your subject. What are they doing? That is the predicate.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Add a Predicate to complete this sentence: The hungry tiger _______________.
subjective_practice.hint: Think of what a hungry tiger would do. (e.g., roars loudly, eats the meat)

activity_or_assignment.title: ✂️ Mix and Match Game
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Write 5 Subjects on blue slips of paper and 5 Predicates on yellow slips of paper. Mix them up and try to draw one of each to make funny new sentences!

chapter_summary: ⭐ A sentence is a group of words that makes complete sense.
⭐ A sentence begins with a capital letter and ends with a full stop.
⭐ The Subject is 'who' or 'what' the sentence is about.
⭐ The Predicate tells us what the Subject is doing or being.
